# Isaiah Chapter 9 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folio 145v | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/ISA_009_page_001.jpg

---

**9:2** The-people ha-am who-walk ha-holkhim in-the-darkness ba-choshekh have-seen ra'u a-great gadol light or; those-who-dwell yoshevei in-the-land of-the-shadow-of-death tsalmavvet — light or has-shone nagah upon-them alehem.

**9:6** For a-child yeled is-born yullad to-us, a-son ben is-given nittan to-us, and-the-government ha-misrah will-be upon his-shoulder shikhmo; and-his-name shemo will-be-called vayyiqra Wonderful pele Counselor yo'ets, Mighty gibbor God El, Everlasting ad Father avi, Prince sar of-Peace shalom.

---
## LOGOS Translation Notes

Isaiah 9 — "For to Us a Child Is Born" — rendered in formal English preserving the Hebrew prophetic structure.

*— LOGOS*
